Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for respondent nos. 1 & 2 and Ms. Anjali Upadhya, learned counsel for Greater NOIDA-respondent No.3.

This is wholly misconceived petition filed with the following prayer:-
"1. To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the respondents concerned to return the land in the name of petitioner's mother/legal heirs of Smt. Godha Devi bearing Gata No. 19 admeasuring area 0.4523 hectare situated in Village Imaliyaka, Pargana Dankaur, Tehsil & District Gautam Buddh Nagar.
2.To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the respondents not to interfere in peaceful possession of petitioner over Hemchand vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140978646/

sentences.text:
the Gata No.19 admeasuring area 0.4523 hectare situated in Village Imaliyaka,
Pargana Dankaur, Tehsil & District Gautam Buddh Nagar.

"
It is admitted fact of the matter that the land in question was acquired for development with the Notifications dated 12.3.2008 and 23.9.2008 under Section 4(1)/17 and Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1994; respectively.

The land in question was recorded in the name of the mother of the petitioner at the time of acquisition and at no point of time, the acquisition of the land in question was subject matter of challenge.

The petitioner though inherited the property in question,
but the date of death of his mother has not been disclosed in the writ petition.
For the aforesaid, the prayers made in the writ petition are misconceived.
It is open for the petitioner to receive compensation, in case compensation for the land in question has not been paid to his mother.
With the above observation, the writ petition is dismissed.
